text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. If I recall, you're Happy Meek, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume trained by Kiryuin—a 
prestigious name in the trainer world, 
acknowledged even by Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Even if they seem completely spaced out, 
you can't let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Bring it on! Any Umamusume capable 
of making us get serious is more than 
welcome—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where did they go?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? She was right there a second 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Scouting mission... My heart is 
pounding...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: When did she...?!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I heard... "The prestigious Kiryuin 
trainer family"... So I thought you 
came... To spy on us...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: W-Who's scouting around here, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, we're being coached by 
Trainer Kashimoto herself.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ah, scouting is entirely unnecessary! I 
declare that our running alone will be 
more than enough to surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh... My Trainer is... amazing too...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...Studying... so much... and thinking 
up... all kinds of regimens..."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto does that too, doesn't 
she? Every day, she checks our condition 
and adjusts the training to suit our 
needs.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Her reflexes are... great, too... She 
can do... parkour and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well that's...! Really hard to argue 
with!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
B-But even Trainer Kashimoto managed to do 
a forward roll at least once!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... I-I'm so sorry for my Mejiro 
Bright...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...No. Likewise.
